note: The one build list of SoftwareFactory, in order. One piece is 'now'. A step counts only when a real ticket on a real product went through it. How a piece is worked: docs/build-loop.md.

steps.title: First safe ticket
steps.line: One sentence becomes a checked result on a real project, inside the fence.

pieces.title: The fence: a closed room and a nine-line self-test before every run
pieces.done: All nine lines pass on the laptop.

pieces.title: The record: one list of what happened, never rewritten
pieces.done: Every screen line is drawn from it.

pieces.title: One run in the room, checked by SoftwareFactory, proposed on GitHub
pieces.done: Ticket T3 on RoadToMill passed and became a draft pull request.

pieces.title: Home screen: sentence, live run, ticket stories
pieces.done: A real ticket is typed and watched on it.

pieces.title: Accept, Stop and Undo
pieces.done: Each is pressed once on a real ticket and the record shows it.

pieces.title: Watchdog beside SoftwareFactory
pieces.done: It speaks when SoftwareFactory goes away in the middle of a real run.

pieces.title: One real window: the safe path inside the installed app
pieces.done: The installed app opens the home screen; no black window, no starter file.

pieces.title: The project tells its own checks: nothing to fill in
pieces.done: A ticket runs on RoadToMill with empty settings.

steps.title: Tickets
steps.line: Many sentences, one front door, each with its story.

pieces.title: Ticket list with create, edit, delete and kinds
pieces.done: Three real tickets are opened, one edited, one deleted, from the screen.

pieces.title: Queue: tickets worked one after another
pieces.done: Three sentences typed in a row all end with a written end.

pieces.title: Ready gate: SoftwareFactory fills the test of done and asks once when a sentence is unclear
pieces.done: An unclear sentence is asked about before any run; a clear one is not.

pieces.title: Ticket story with proof at every step
pieces.done: A finished ticket shows each step with its proof.

pieces.title: Parked with a reason, and back to the gate
pieces.done: A parked ticket returns and finishes.

pieces.title: GitHub in step, both ways
pieces.done: An issue opened on GitHub appears as a ticket, and the other way round.

steps.title: Runs alone
steps.line: Go by default, inside limits, and he can always stop.

pieces.title: Go by default: two runs at once, sleep is not run time
pieces.done: Tickets finish while you are away.

pieces.title: The stop list: actions that always wait for you
pieces.done: A run that tries one is blocked and the factory goes on.

pieces.title: Two limits and SoftwareFactory's own share
pieces.done: A run parks at the limit and keeps its work.

pieces.title: Since you left
pieces.done: You return to one screen that says what finished, what did not and why.

pieces.title: Stuck ladder: once more, another way, split, park
pieces.done: A failing ticket climbs the ladder by itself.

pieces.title: Phone, two ways: told, and can stop
pieces.done: You stop a run from the phone.

pieces.title: Every number and switch is a setting; the protected core only by your hand
pieces.done: You change a limit from the screen; an agent cannot.

steps.title: Projects
steps.line: Every product has one home, and SoftwareFactory looks after it.

pieces.title: Project home and all projects on one screen
pieces.done: RoadToMill and a second product each show one colour and one sentence.

pieces.title: Bring a project in with one action
pieces.done: A product is pointed at and proven to run in the fence.

pieces.title: Live check: reads changes, runs it, walks the main paths
pieces.done: A real new bug is found with proof.

pieces.title: Sorting of machine-made tickets
pieces.done: A finding is accepted, another declined with a reason.

pieces.title: Idea bank and the first doors for ideas
pieces.done: Your idea is caught in one sentence and stays in your words.

steps.title: Ways of working
steps.line: Several ways to build, compared on real tickets.

pieces.title: One contract for every way of working
pieces.done: The first way runs through it unchanged.

pieces.title: A second way: the spec line
pieces.done: A real ticket is finished by it.

pieces.title: Races with a blind judge
pieces.done: The same real ticket is built two ways and judged.

pieces.title: Score with weights you can set
pieces.done: Best, fastest and cheapest are shown per ticket.

pieces.title: Choice rule: a way takes a kind of case after a lead of three wins
pieces.done: SoftwareFactory picks the way and says why in one line.

steps.title: Agents
steps.line: Workers he can create, edit and trust by proof.

pieces.title: Agent cards with create, edit, delete and versions
pieces.done: You make an agent by saying it and it works a ticket.

pieces.title: Trust states: unproven, not worse, proven, retired
pieces.done: An agent's state changes by results only.

pieces.title: Swap tests on fresh tickets
pieces.done: One agent is swapped and the count decides.

pieces.title: Lessons as proposed changes
pieces.done: A lesson is tried like any change before it stays.

pieces.title: Skill shelf
pieces.done: A skill is added from the screen and used in a run.

steps.title: Ideas to products
steps.line: Ideas are cooked, tried small, and released with one yes.

pieces.title: Cooking ideas in rounds
pieces.done: One of your ideas reaches ready with a plan and a test of done.

pieces.title: Experiments: quick proof, first version, riskiest part
pieces.done: A cooked idea becomes a small working thing.

pieces.title: Release: one bundle, one picture, one yes
pieces.done: A real product is released from the screen.

pieces.title: Passes per account, project and purpose
pieces.done: A run uses an account only with its pass.

steps.title: Scan, bench and the town
steps.line: The outside world feeds SoftwareFactory, safely.

pieces.title: Test bench: a throwaway room that can only fail a find
pieces.done: A find is installed, measured and thrown away.

pieces.title: The scan: your drop box, search on need, a small weekly look
pieces.done: A saved link gets an answer.

pieces.title: The weekly picture
pieces.done: You get one picture of what got in and what it improved.

pieces.title: The AI user
pieces.done: It orders work through the side door and cannot raise limits.

pieces.title: The town
pieces.done: Every movement on it is a real event.

pieces.title: Other machines with the same fence
pieces.done: A run works on a second machine.
